scripts.dev: concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -s first -n web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm -w src/shared run build && npm -w src/api run build && npm -w src/web run build
scripts.type:check: npm -w src/shared run type:check && npm -w src/api run type:check && npm -w src/web run type:check
scripts.source:check: npm run biome:check && npm run type:check
scripts.test: concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -s first -n web,api "npm run test:web" "npm run test:api"
scripts.test:ci: npm -w src/web run test:ci && npm -w src/api run test:ci

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npm run test:ci && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:api-types && git add src/api/openapi.json src/web/src/api/generated
